thread:
mira_cs: Hi all — kicking off Pelican onboarding. Quick goals for sprint-0 (10 days): 1) integrate Redwood Hosted into Pelican support pipeline, 2) run a 10-sample latency + cost benchmark, 3) Console runbook session for their CSMs. Who owns what?

jon_pm: I'll be Pelican PM contact. Weekly sync Fri 9am PT works. I'll add their infra lead (Cara) to an intro email after this.

cara_sre: Cara (Pelican SRE) here. We require EU data residency and IP allowlist for webhooks. Happy to work with infra team; will share CIDRs.

leo_success: I'll draft success criteria: (a) staging E2E ticket flow validated; (b) 95th percentile latency <400ms on sample set; (c) CSMs complete the Console checklist. If go-live slips past Day 30 mark renewal risk and escalate.

ryan_se: I'll take model selection + integration pairing. Need 10 anonymized tickets and a sample webhook payload. I'll post a smoke-test curl and a small Node example.

onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist: /docs/onboarding/pelican-template. Complete security questionnaire for EU residency step.

mira_cs: Action items: 1) jon to intro Cara + infra by EOD; 2) Pelican to provide staging keys + 10 anon tickets by Day 2; 3) ryan to share smoke tests Day 1-2; 4) leo to post acceptance tests Day 2; 5) I'll create sprint board and assign owners today.

jon_pm: Intro email sent. I'll request anonymized tickets export and compliance contacts.

cara_sre: Opening infra ticket for IP allowlist/peering. ETA 48h review. If peering delayed we accept secure proxy routing.

ryan_se: Quick curl smoke-test to share with their engineers:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize ticket body"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

leo_success: I'll validate routing options and fallback (EU region) by tomorrow and post cost delta if Dedicated is required.

mira_cs: First sync Fri 9am PT — calendar invite incoming. Small ask: after first 48h please have CSMs run the Console checklist and give feedback on any gaps. :thumbsup:

jon_pm: CSMs will join. Excited to get started.

(onboarding thread ended)
